The '''''Space Slug''''' was a ''[[Tallaan Clipper]]'' transport in use during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Both the [[Kedorzhan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Dewell Bronk]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] booked passage on the ship while trying to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

[[File:Kenobi_Incognito_Insider_143.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Obi-Wan Kenobi tries to leave Coruscant with the infant Luke Skywalker]]
Bronk was attempting to escape persecution due to his part in the [[Delegation of 2000]], and Kenobi was attempting to reach the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with the infant [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Whilst the pair was on board it's [[Unidentified first officer (Space Slug)|first officer]] was drunk and ignored a pair [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] thugs who began harassing a elderly [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Unidentified elderly Twi'lek female|passenger]]. Bronk attempted to help but failed, after which Kenobi used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|persuade]] the pair to leave. Bronk then aided Kenobi in looking after Luke, following which the vessel arrived at its [[Unidentified planet green-skied planet|destination]] where passengers had to transfer to different ships to continue their journeys.
